name: wicked noodle
ingredients_raw: Instant Noodles: Whole Wheat Flour 65.9%, Split Moong Beans Flour (Moong Dal) 8%, Oats Flour 6%, Brown Rice Flour 5.5%, Gluten, Tapioca Starch, Jowar Flour, Salt, Stabilizer (Xanthan Gum) Spices & condiments (Onion, Garlic, Cumin, Coriander, Turmeric, Chilli), Sugar, Iodised salt, Hydrolysed Vegetable Protein (Soya), Corn Starch, Dehydrated Vegetable (Carrot, Peas), Yeast extract powder, Flavour enhancer (INS 627, INS 631), Tomato powder, Tamarind powder, Milk Solids, (Natural & Nature Identical) flavouring substances, Anticaking agent (Silicon Dioxide), Acidity regulator (citric acid), Natural Colour (INS 150d), Thickener (Guar Gum, Xanthan Gum). CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL COLOUR (INS 150d) & ADDED FLAVOURS (NATURAL & NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES)
